title: Error Boundaries, Loading States & Feature Composition
objectives: Design a consistent error/loading UI contract
Compose features into pages without coupling them
Add error boundaries so one failure does not blank the app

examples.name: states.ts

exercise.prompt: A widget in the sidebar throws. What should the user see? Rank: "whole app unmounts", "sidebar shows fallback, rest of page works", "silent console error", "infinite spinner".
hints: Error boundaries scope failures to the failing region.
Announce failures accessibly (role=alert) — silence is not UX.

options: contain a failure to its region with a graceful fallback
questions.explanation: Boundaries trade a small broken region for a working page.

questions.prompt: Feature composition keeps pages manageable by…
options: assembling independent features that communicate via props/stores/routes
questions.explanation: Independent features compose like components — replaceable and testable in isolation.
